Lydia / Tom — quick technical checklist so you know what we'll ask for during the call:
- High-level network diagram (VPCs, subnets, peering, NAT/GCLB) — 1 slide or a draw.io/export is fine
- Expected peak QPS for inference, average sequence length, and token sizes
- Data flow: any PHI/PPI concerns, whether payloads persist in storage
- Auth: SSO provider (SAML/OIDC), and whether you require customer-managed KMS/HSM
- If you plan to evaluate Dedicated vs Private, note permitted egress IP ranges (we'll discuss routing/fallbacks)

Optional but helpful: a short list of example prompts or payload sizes so we can run quick perf estimates during the session.

I'll be leading the Serving & SLO section in the agenda — will prepare 2–3 slides showing latency/cost tradeoffs with batching, KV cache, and quantization options.

Thanks — Rishi
